title: Evolution of the Thermometer, 1592–1743
lineage: Inspected primary text or later historical source; see locator and qualification.

passages.locator: Chapter IV, Fahrenheit papers and scale discussion
passages.note: Fahrenheit’s 1724 papers described thermometry using a scale referenced to a cold mixture and human body heat. This is a later historical reconstruction, not the original paper. Modern fixed-point definitions should not be projected onto every early instrument.
